info.name: Substrate API Sidecar accounts pallets API
pallets
Get information and metadata associated with an asset.

params.name: assetId
params.description: The unsignedInteger Id of an asset.

params.name: at
params.description: Block at which to retrieve the assetInfo.

params.name: useRcBlock
params.description: When set to 'true', uses the relay chain block specified in the 'at' parameter to determine corresponding Asset Hub block(s) for retrieving asset info. Only supported for Asset Hub endpoints. Requires 'at' parameter to specify the relay chain block. When used, returns an array of response objects (one for each Asset Hub block found) or empty array if none found.

params.name: useRcBlockFormat
params.description: Controls the response format when using 'useRcBlock=true'. When set to 'object', wraps the response in an object containing relay chain block info ('rcBlock') and the parachain data array ('parachainDataPerBlock'). When set to 'array' or omitted, returns the standard array format. Only valid when 'useRcBlock=true' is specified.

items.docs: Returns information associated with an asset which includes the assets `AssetDetails` and `AssetMetadata`.

items.docs: Returns a list of all validators addresses and their corresponding status which can be either active or waiting. For declared validators, it also includes their commission rate and nomination blocking status. It will also return a list of active validators that will not be part of the next era for staking.
